# Armagetron Advanced for macOS — v0.4.0-3.0

This release adds a named colour palette with an in-game colour creator, an
invisible "ghost" mode for observing a server without joining it, and a search
box for the server browser.

## Highlights

- **Colour palette**: save named player colours, preview the bike and the two
  trail shades a colour produces, and build new ones channel by channel in a
  colour creator.
- **Ghost client**: connect and watch without appearing in the player list or
  producing a join message.
- **Server browser search**: an `f` shortcut jumps to the filter, and the list
  keeps loading while you type.

## New Features

### Colours

- **Colors menu** in Modded Settings, below Cockpits. Saved colours live in
  `colors.txt` and each row shows the bike and the two trail shades it produces.
- **Create, edit, rename, delete**: `n` starts a new colour from the highlighted
  one, `e` edits its channels, `r` renames it, `delete` removes it, and `enter`
  applies it.
- **Colour creator**: three channel columns. `left`/`right` pick a channel,
  `up`/`down` change the value, digits and `-` type it directly, and `enter`
  saves it under a name.
- **Three lists**: the saved colours live in three independent columns; plain
  arrows move the cursor, and `shift`+arrows move a colour within its list or
  into a neighbouring one. The change is kept in `colors.txt`.
- **Local and server markers**: `+` marks the colour chosen locally, `#` the one
  the server has, so it is obvious when a skin has not reached the server yet.
- **Overflow preview**: values above 15 (or negative) wrap the bike while the
  trail saturates, giving one colour a different bike and trail. The menu flags
  this, and `documentation/colors_and_overflow.md` explains the maths.
- **Live application**: applying a colour recolours the current cycle at once,
  pushes it to the server immediately, and is applied to the next round even if
  the server has not caught up yet.
- **Console commands**: `SAVECOLOR <name> [player]`, `SETCOLOR <name>`,
  `DELCOLOR <name>`, `NEXTCOLOR` and `COLORS`.

### Ghost client

- **GHOST_CLIENT** setting and a Modded Settings toggle. While it is on the client
  keeps no player, so the server sees a machine without players and the other
  players get neither a list entry nor a join/leave or spectator message.
- The client still runs the game and renders normally; a small white triangle
  marks the state, and only shows once your player is really gone.
- Turn it on **before** connecting to enter a server unnoticed. Toggling it while
  playing leaves and rejoins.

### Server browser

- The filter row is now a **search box** and the browser opens on it, so you can
  type a search straight away; `f` jumps back to it from anywhere in the list.
- The column headers and server-query polling are drawn by every browser row, so
  they keep working while the filter has the cursor.
- The host-game and filter rows are pinned to the top of the list.

### Modded Settings

- **Font settings** and **Misc** submenus: the font options moved into Font
  settings, and the ghost client, client version and settings key moved into
  Misc.
- The in-game HUD map binding is gone. The minimap is switched with `M` inside
  the cockpit menu only, so it cannot be changed by accident while playing, and
  the map key is no longer repeated in the cockpit details.

## Bug Fixes

- **Server browser**: the sort shortcuts no longer swallow text typed into the
  search box.

## Known Issues

- **Ghost client**: `NETWORK_SPECTATOR_TIME` on a server kicks player-less clients
  after that many seconds (0, the default, never kicks). The server admin can
  still see the connection.
- **Colours**: a pure white bike forces a white trail; you cannot have a white
  bike and a saturated trail from one colour, because both read the same bytes.
  See `documentation/colors_and_overflow.md`.
- The app is **not signed or notarised**. After unzipping, right-click the app
  and choose **Open** once, and macOS will allow it from then on.
